title: Player falls through thin floor at high speed
body: When player falls from height > 1000px, move_and_slide sometimes allows tunneling through StaticBody2D floor.
patch:
diff --git a/player.gd b/player.gd
--- a/player.gd
+++ b/player.gd
@@ -10,3 +10,4 @@
-    velocity.y = min(velocity.y + gravity * delta, 2000.0)
+    velocity.y = min(velocity.y + gravity * delta, 800.0)
root_cause: Uncapped terminal velocity exceeded collision margin thickness.
